CustomField.label: Applies When (Count Query)
CustomField.description: A COUNT() SOQL query used only to decide whether this check applies - it is not part of the pass/fail logic. Required when "Applies To" is "When a count query matches". Its returned count is compared using "Count Must Be" and "Count Value"; the check runs only when that comparison is true, otherwise it is Skipped. Supports merge tokens such as {!record.Id}. Leave blank for any other "Applies To" choice.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Required when "Applies To" = "When a count query matches". A COUNT() query, e.g. SELECT COUNT() FROM Contract WHERE AccountId = {!record.Id} AND Status = 'Active'. Compared using "Count Must Be" and "Count Value".
